correctness.rationale: Explicit multiplication computes the alternating 6×6 pairing. Its entry ideal has valuation a; its nonzero 4×4 Pfaffians ±st,±sh,±th,±h² determine the second exponent b; the six-Pfaffian is zero. Standard alternating Smith elimination, valid in characteristic two, gives kernel cardinality q^{2(a+b+ℓ)} over every commutative chain ring. Nondegenerate additive characters then yield Fourier coefficients q^{8ℓ+2(a+b)}, and exact valuation-shell character sums yield fixed-target fiber formula (1). All quantifiers include every finite q, ℓ≥1, target and input pair. Embedded checker exhaustively verifies full small frequency sets over Z4 and F2[ε]/ε², tests partial larger rings, and directly checks bracket fibers over F2; finite checks are not universal proofs.

value.rationale: The complete fixed-target additive-commutator distribution of T3 over all nonfield chain rings is a natural finite associative-ring/Lie-bracket invariant, not a routine single numerical instance. Universality across nonisomorphic equal-(q,ℓ) rings, a fully positive 2ℓ+1-level Fourier spectrum and an exact sharp gap q^{-2} provide substantive structural consequences. Existing field-only and 2×2 restrictions do not supply the parameter-rich nonfield claim.
